question: According to ‘Population estimation of tigers in reserves for 2018-19’ which of the following is India's largest tiger reserve?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Corbett**__.

__
 
• **According to ‘Population estimation of tigers in reserves for 2018-19’ Corbett is India's largest tiger reserve**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jim Corbett National Park** is located in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand State.

 
 
• It was the first Indian National Park(Hailey National Park renamed as Corbett National park) that was established in 1936.
 
• The park was first to come under the Project Tiger initiative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Tiger Reserve**
 **Details**
 
 

 Bandipore
 
 
 
• It is located in Gundul pet taluk, Chamarajnagar district, **Karnataka**.
 
• It is a part of the Niligiri Biosphere Reserve.
 
• The park shares boundaries with three other national parks namely Nagarhole, Wayanad, Mudumalai.
 
• It comes under Project Tiger.
 
 
 
 

 Nagarhole
 
 
 
• Nagarhole national park is located in the Kodagu and Mysore districts of **Karnataka**.
 
• The park derives its name from Naga meaning snake and hole meaning streams.
 
• It is a part of the Niligiri Biosphere Reserve. 
 
 
 
 

 Dudhwa
 
 
 
• Dudhwa national park is located in the Terai belt of marshy grasslands in northern **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The park is located on the Indo-Nepal border.
